x: It was good to see Minahan racing again after a long lapse through injury and it is hoped that he will be able to continue his training. Good performances were put up by Adams (11th), England (12th) and Chantler (14th) to complete our scoring six.

Stone the Surrey cross-country champion and our first man home was Roy Minahan in eighth place. With the individuals being deleted we managed to come out on top in the team race but only by the narrow margin of one point over Wadham Harriers, with Thames Valley third.
